text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Soft, fluffy, radiant skin with a natural
glow."
"A hydration revolution for
buoyant, youthful
skin."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What language is this?! And wow, does
it reek! Dammit, I just want to fix my
breakout, not deal
with all this makeup
BS!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have time to waste waiting
for
delivery. It's best to buy it in person.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like I'm gathering all this
data for
fun. I should be able to use it to
find the perfect
solution!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So the components of skin are... which
means the
essential component is...
So,
the optimal product is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That new lotion, huh? Well, let's do a
quick te—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Various unwanted factors have Air
Shakur
worrying about the condition of
her skin.
